misconception_description: Student believes that variable identifiers can only be one letter long.

solutions.generated_code:
program JumlahRentang
kamus
  n, a, e, i, x, t : integer
algoritma
  input(n, a, e)
  t <- 0
  for i <- 1 to n do
    input(x)
    if i >= a and i <= e then
      t <- t + x
    endif
  endfor
  output(t)
endprogram
